name: geon0407.github.io
description: Personal blog and portfolio of GeonHyoung Kim (based on the Vonge Jekyll template)

scripts.jekyll:install: bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle' && BUNDLE_GEMFILE=site/Gemfile bundle install
scripts.build: BUNDLE_GEMFILE=site/Gemfile bundle exec jekyll build --source site
scripts.start: BUNDLE_GEMFILE=site/Gemfile bundle exec jekyll serve --source site --port 6060 --trace --unpublished

author: GeonHyoung Kim
